_comment: COOK-23: the ONE source of truth for who may edit and delete a recipe.
Read by the backend handler tests (backend/test/ownership.test.js, against the real PUT and DELETE handlers)
and by the frontend tests of canEdit/canDelete (frontend/src/lib/ownership.test.js), so the server rule and
the SPA's idea of which controls to show cannot drift. Change the rule here, in backend/src/services/ownership.js
Keyed by the Ownership ruling's option, then the Unattributed-recipes ruling's option, then rows.
actor: author = the signed-in recipe author; other = a different signed-in contributor; signedOut = no session.
recipe: attributed = has a contributor (the author, for the author row); unattributed = contributorId is NULL.
edit/delete are the expected HTTP status of PUT and DELETE; the SPA shows the control exactly when it is 2xx.
